notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.content:
[b]Version 1.1 of keyg is released![/b]

Here what it includes:

[list]
[*] Lots of bug fixes. Probably some are still there, so don't be shy, tell me about them.
[*] Lots of level corrections. Some were too difficult, some too confusing. Now I hope it's fine.
[*] 1 new level that I think is necessary.
[*] Something else that I forgot about.
[/list]

To celebrate the new patch keyg is on sale for 1 week!

Thanks to everyone who played and will be playing my game! Love ya all.
